{{Top|leg}}
The '''Hargeevans''' were the native [[Human/Legends|Human]] population of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hargeeva]]. The Hargeevans settled Hargeeva 2,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] but when support was cut off they reverted to a feudal state. The planet was incorporated into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] around [[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]] and the local ruler, [[Makintay]], was raised to the post of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]]. Makintay's son, [[Stevan Makintay]], eventually joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], followed several years later by the [[metallurgist]] [[Ketrian Altronel]].<ref name="Firepower">{{JournalCite|8|Firepower}}</ref>
